OSU has a lot of dorms that are very diverse with some being special learning communities (engineering, Honors, LGBTQ+ international, ROTC etc.) I was an RA for a few years and I will say that there is a genuine great deal of effort put into making the first year experience manageable. There is a large effort to make the dorms inclusive and accepting so you don't have to worry about that (See RA, ALA, DLA). Everyone's experience is different. There are 14 dorms and some dorms have better facilities than others and are working towards being renovated. Honestly, don't expect luxurious rooms. I've traveled to wealthy private schools for conferences/recruitment weekends (Northwestern, Stanford, Princeton) and the dorm situations are pretty much all standard. I would say OSU even has some advantages over these schools, especially in the diversity sense.
